name: MYANMAR

flag.title: Flag of Myanmar
flag.note: Tricolour with large white star at centre

lead: Myanmar is in Southeast Asia, next to Thailand and India. Golden temples dot the land. Snow covers the northern mountains. Coral islands sit in the warm southern sea. People from 135 groups live here.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Myanmar is shaped like a kite with a long tail. The Irrawaddy River flows almost its whole length. It carries silt (rich mud) to the central plains, where most rice grows.
The south narrows into a long finger of land by the Andaman Sea. In the far north, Hkakabo Razi stays snowy all year. It is Southeast Asia's highest peak.
animals: Tigers, Asian elephants, and clouded leopards live in Myanmar's forests. The rare Irrawaddy dolphin swims in the great river.
Gurney's pitta is one of the world's rarest birds. The Burmese star tortoise nearly died out, but it is coming back.
culture: Most people in Myanmar are Buddhist. The Thingyan water festival lasts four days in April. People splash each other to wash away bad luck.
Everyone wears a longyi, a tube of colourful cloth, at the waist. Mohinga, a fish-noodle soup, is the national breakfast. Laphet is a salad of pickled tea leaves.
history: The Pagan Kingdom built over 10,000 temples from the 11th century. More than 2,000 still stand today. By 1885, Britain ruled the whole country.
Myanmar won independence in 1948. General Aung San, Father of the Nation, was killed six months before. Soldiers have ruled for long periods since.
wows: Bagan packs more ancient temples per square km than almost anywhere.
Naypyidaw's 20-lane highway sat almost empty for years.
Hkakabo Razi, at 5,881 m, is Southeast Asia's tallest mountain.
Wild Irrawaddy dolphins herd fish into fishermen's nets.
Myanmar is the top ruby producer, with the finest from Mogok Valley.
Scientists feared the Burmese star tortoise was gone, but breeding brought it back.
At dawn, hot-air balloons float over 2,000 pagodas in Bagan.

myths.myth: Myanmar and Burma are different countries
myths.fact: Same country. The military government renamed it Myanmar in 1989. Burma is the older English name.
Many people in Myanmar have just one name. Parents often pick it using the weekday the baby was born.
